description: #749 refusal regressions: an anchor-anchored path call is trusted bookkeeping only when its remaining arguments are demonstrably static. Request/user/argv operands, bracket access (req[...]), f-string operands with adjacent quotes, deep nesting (any depth), and pathlib division chaining (Path(__file__).parent / request.args[...]) all REFUSE trusted-neutralization and fire untrusted_source_join: path_handling kind, flag, and provenance.
diff:
diff --git a/src/app/serve.py b/src/app/serve.py
+++ b/src/app/serve.py
@@ -1,2 +1,4 @@
+dest = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.joinpath(request.args["path"])
+target = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), user_supplied_name)
diff --git a/src/app/serve.ts b/src/app/serve.ts
+++ b/src/app/serve.ts
@@ -1,3 +1,7 @@
+const p = path.resolve(__dirname, req.query.path);
+const uploadName = req.query.name;
+const dest = path.join(__dirname, uploadName);
+const arg = path.resolve(__dirname, process.argv[2]);
diff --git a/src/app/serve_extra.py b/src/app/serve_extra.py
+++ b/src/app/serve_extra.py
@@ -1,3 +1,7 @@
+joined = os.path.join(base, f'{env}/', request.args['p'])
+deep = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.realpath(os.path.join(BASE, 'safe'))), request.args['q'])
+divided = Path(__file__).parent / request.args['x']
